kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual get-thing-event-snapshot --identifier AlarmType --product-key a1Bw000000 --device-name Device01 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2023-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetThingEventSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The event identifier of the thing model
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the video device.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video device.
<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。
<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

error: fault

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the event occurred. Unit: milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 事件发生的时间戳。单位为毫秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
